issues: 两个场景都是灰色占位 dashboard，转场前后讲不出任何东西，i18n 胶囊和画面内容没有关系
气泡是均匀的粉紫珠光球，浅灰底上发灰发闷，峰值时整屏是一片模糊的白色色块
胶囊夹在中层气泡里，峰值时被巨型泡盖成半透明，读不清
散开直接外推，没有预备，力度平；新场景落定后没有任何揭示动作
changes: look 换成 porcelain（冷白 · 钴蓝），转场被赋予语义：虚构本地化产品 Verbatim 的英文落地页被「Hallo! / ¡Hola! / こんにちは」漫过，散开后同一页面已是德文版（EN → DE、语言进度全部 100% ✓）
页面按镜头重做：1600×900 浏览器窗，104px 两行标题 + 36px 说明 + CTA，右栏语言覆盖率卡；德文版标题逐词由虚到实、状态条错峰亮起
气泡改成真正的肥皂膜：中心近透明、外缘 conic 薄膜虹彩环（钴蓝 / 紫 / 粉 / 青 / 金）、窗格形镜面反光 + 回光、钴蓝发丝外缘；6 颗巨型泡更厚，按网格兜底遮满
节奏：涨潮 ease-out 68f → 74f 藏切 → 6f 全体向心内收 3%（预备）→ 30f 径向 ease-in 飞散 + 沿速度拉伸；洗白峰值提到 0.95
胶囊画在最上层、50px 大字 + 钴蓝语言代码，峰值也读得清；时长 130f → 150f，尾段 26f 干净的德文版海报
issuesEn: Both scenes were grey placeholder dashboards, so the transition said nothing, and the i18n capsules had no link to what was on screen
Bubbles were uniform pink-purple pearls that looked dull and grey on the light background; at the peak the screen was just a blurry white mass
Capsules sat inside the middle layer and were half-covered by the giant bubbles at the peak, so they were hard to read
The dispersal pushed straight out with no anticipation and little force, and nothing was revealed after the new scene landed
changesEn: Porcelain look (cool white, cobalt) and a transition with meaning: the English landing page of a fictional localisation product, Verbatim, is swamped by 'Hallo! / ¡Hola! / こんにちは', and when the swarm clears the same page is in German (EN → DE, every language at 100% ✓)

Page rebuilt for the shot: a 1600×900 browser window, a 104px two-line headline, a 36px line and CTA, with a language-coverage card on the right; the German headline resolves word by word from blur and status items light up in sequence

Bubbles are now real soap film: a nearly clear centre, a conic thin-film iridescent rim (cobalt, violet, pink, cyan, gold), a window-pane specular highlight plus bounce light, and a hairline cobalt edge; the six giant bubbles are denser and grid-placed to guarantee full cover
Rhythm: 68f ease-out swell → hidden cut at 74f → 6f inward gather of 3% (anticipation) → 30f radial ease-in burst with velocity stretch; the whiteout peak is raised to 0.95
Capsules draw on top with 50px type and cobalt language codes, legible even at the peak; 130f → 150f with a 26f clean German-page poster at the end
